claims.title: Sample balanced short-time native laws or supplied uniformly pin-controlled tensor laws

quoted_fields.interface: For the native sampler: rational product rho0 and finite rational local POVMs, arbitrary rational piecewise simultaneous finite-range GKLS schedule, fixed range/arity/incidence and g=J/gamma, and fixed permitted eta_max. Require fixed rational lambda>0 with p_i(x)=Tr(M_i rho_i)>=lambda t_i(x), t_i=Tr(M_i)/2, for EVERY nonzero effect, plus the explicit short-time bound. For the separate representation sampler: a SUPPLIED bounded-degree tensor graph with fixed bond dimension/output-block size, normalized rational edge states and explicit paid Gram decompositions for every needed measurement pin (including unpinned sites), with uniformly small kappa and correct exact-zero handling. No such representation is presumed constructed for arbitrary native evolution.
quoted_fields.failure: Fixed balanced overlap excludes some allowed pure preparations/measurements, and the short-time window is not an all-time eta_sample. Restarting successive slabs discards a correlated quantum state. The rare-set bound is unconditional for fixed site sets: it supplies neither independent flags nor uniform estimates after arbitrary other pins, and small rare regions can couple through ordinary sites/histories. Uniform pin-Gram sampling requires its explicit representation; unpinned strong injectivity/BP fixed-depth strong-noise results do not establish arbitrary native pin stability. The Bell obstruction needs the stronger ALL-positive-endpoint-effect/common-linear-scalar/geometrically bounded physical representation; it does not rule out a representation only for one classical measurement law or establish sampling hardness. The negative-eta zero uses analytic continuation ONLY. It rejects one uniform eta=0-centered log disk over all early pins; easy native pairs and local exact resummation remain. An exact TP Doob gauge needs a positive invertible harmonic h_s solving K_s_star(h_s)+h_s_prime=0; K_s(I)=0 is a different property. Here h_s is the actual forward-evolved density operator, and the transformed initial pin is generally correlated/normalized; pure terminal preparation also needs paid regularization. This is an unresolved computational object, not impossibility.
